testcase.name: Coordinate encoders saturate finite bounds and encode non-finite values as zero()
Tuning and device PIN use full unsigned little-endian words()
Login and discovery preserve source prefix behavior()
Binary requests cover every original subtype and optional payload()
Contact layout preserves unknown raw type padding and excludes last-modified timestamp()
Radio false repeat is present zero and low-level SF CR pass through()
Set name preserves complete UTF8 graphemes at firmware 31-byte boundary()
Persisted flood-scope overloads derive keys without changing clear semantics()
Auto-add config retains unknown bits and all maximum-hop byte values()
Control and tagged node discovery preserve optional since and zero explicit tag()
Other params exhaustively masks three two-bit telemetry fields and optional ACK byte()
Every original public builder overload is present()
Direct messages retain plain type retry prefix and raw UTF8 without hidden truncation()
Implicit node discovery tag is always a full-range nonzero word()
Channel name is fixed width while the source key only truncates()
Trace fields are LE and optional path is passed through()
Radio encoder uses Swift half-away rounding and handles multiplication overflow()
App identifier prefix counts graphemes rather than bytes or UTF16 units()
Anonymous requests reverse bytes rather than multi-byte hop groups()
Session flood-scope reset and explicit unscoped commands remain distinct()
All 256 path hash mode input bytes are source-clamped()
Legacy key commands truncate oversized fields without padding short inputs()
Date fields truncate fractional seconds and saturate the full Instant range()
Raw data clamp boundaries preserve zero empty and maximum fields independently()
Custom variables and signing raw bytes retain full payload()
